original:
Let $n\geq 2$ , let $G$ and $H$ be finite abelian groups whose exponents divide
 $n$ , and let $d\geq 0$ . Then

 $A_{n}(G\oplus C_{n}^{d})\ \geq\ 2^{d}A_{n}(G)\qquad\text{and}\qquad A_{n}(G\oplus H)\ \geq\ A_{n}(G).$
